cues.text: Inside Tartarus, twisted growths cover the walls. You walk up to Junpei and Akihiko, who are waiting for you.
Junpei spins around. Some way behind the group stands a pale-faced girl in a school uniform.
You, Junpei and Akihiko walk over to the girl.
Fuuka sinks to her knees on the floor, her hands clasped at her chest. You walk over and crouch in front of her.
Fuuka gets back to her feet, and you stand up with her.
Akihiko holds out an Evoker, and Fuuka takes it in both hands.
